summary: Harvest Moon/Story of Seasons entries follow the farming-life-sim lineage from Victor/Marvelous, including region/name changes and later remakes.

entries.title: Harvest Moon: Back to Nature
entries.definitive_edition: Original PlayStation release, with PSP Boy & Girl documented separately

emulation.notes: Use owned PlayStation copy or prior PSN purchase.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PlayStation release with save/region state documented

primary.version: Original PlayStation release or owned PSN classic
primary.why: Back to Nature is the PlayStation farming-life-sim entry and a key source for Mineral Town. The PSP Boy & Girl release adds the For Girl route, while Story of Seasons: Friends of Mineral Town is a later remake lineage rather than an exact replacement.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned PlayStation copy on hardware or accurate PS1 emulation, or a previously purchased PSN classic where available. Record region, emulator/hardware, season/year/date, farm state, relationship/marriage route, For Girl/Boy & Girl comparison, and whether Friends of Mineral Town was excluded.

secondary.exclusive_content: PSP compilation including Back to Nature and For Girl
secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting both protagonist routes.
secondary.why: The original PlayStation route is the queue target.

secondary.platform: Story of Seasons: Friends of Mineral Town
secondary.why: It is not exact Back to Nature behavior.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record region, season/save state, and whether For Girl/remake routes were excluded.

entries.title: Harvest Moon 64
entries.definitive_edition: Nintendo 64 version through Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack, with original hardware noted for authenticity

emulation.emulator: Nintendo Classics wrapper; Ares/ParaLLEl/N64 hardware only if needed
emulation.notes: Use official service where possible; document controller and any wrapper assist features.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original N64 hardware for behavior; Nintendo Classics for current official access

primary.version: Nintendo 64 version through Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack
primary.why: Harvest Moon 64 is a Nintendo 64-only farming sim with later official Wii U and Nintendo Classics service routes. The Switch Nintendo Classics route is the practical current official route, while original N64 hardware remains the controller/display authenticity reference.
primary.how_to_play: Use Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack if available, or original N64 hardware/accurate N64 emulation for comparison. Record service/app version, region, controller, screen/filter settings, farm year/season/day, marriage/photo/album progress, and whether Wii U VC or original cartridge was compared.

secondary.why: The current service route is practical, but original hardware is the behavior reference.

secondary.exclusive_content: Legacy digital route and PAL debut context
secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting old digital-service behavior.
secondary.why: The eShop purchase path is historical; current access is via Switch service/original hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remake replaces Harvest Moon 64. Record service wrapper, region and save-state/rewind use.

entries.title: Harvest Moon
entries.definitive_edition: SNES version through Nintendo Switch Online / Nintendo Classics, with original SNES hardware as authenticity reference

emulation.emulator: Nintendo Classics wrapper; bsnes/Mesen-S only if official route unavailable
emulation.notes: Record wrapper assist features such as save states/rewind if used.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original SNES hardware for behavior; Nintendo Classics for current official access

primary.platform: Nintendo Switch / Nintendo Classics Super NES
primary.version: SNES version through Nintendo Switch Online
primary.why: The first Harvest Moon is the Super NES original. The current practical official route is Nintendo's SNES Classics/Nintendo Switch Online app where available, while original SNES hardware remains the controller/display authenticity reference.
primary.how_to_play: Use the SNES version through Nintendo Classics if available, or original SNES hardware/accurate emulation. Record service/app version, region, controller, screen/filter settings, year/season/day, farm/marriage state, and whether Game Boy, GBC or later remakes were excluded.

secondary.why: The Switch wrapper is practical; original hardware is the behavior reference.

secondary.platform: Game Boy / Game Boy Color follow-ups
secondary.why: They are not the SNES original.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with later Harvest Moon/Story of Seasons remakes or handheld follow-ups.
